Analyze the entire 'foreman' codebase to deeply understand its purpose, architecture, agents (Visioner, Strategist, Researcher, Worker), and capabilities. Then, generate an absolutely spectacular, show-stopping README.md in English. 

The README must meet these requirements:
1. Cater to both non-technical readers (explaining the concept of an AI coding orchestrator simply) and highly technical developers (deep dive into the pipeline, execution engine, tool usage, and agent orchestration).
2. Heavily decorate the README with impressive ASCII art. Specifically, include a large, detailed ASCII art of a blacksmith forging on an anvil (representing the 'Forge' pipeline), and other industrial/AI agent thematic elements (gears, robots).
3. Make it a masterpiece ("show off") using beautiful Markdown formatting, badges, quotes, and structural elements.
4. Include sections like: Hero/Banner, Features, How It Works (The Forge Pipeline), Architecture, Getting Started, and Capabilities.
